_comment: P7 router: VBUS fan-in/merge pour at J1. The aiee_pwr_width_VBUS DRU rule (min 1.75 mm) is geometrically unmeetable as a TRACK at J1's VBUS pads - the widest track whose copper can touch J1-A4-B9 / J1-B4-A9 while holding the 0.1524 mm clearance floor is 1.465 mm, because CC1/CC2 and the 6 unconnected USB pads sit 0.2 mm away on a 0.5 mm-pitch column. A zone is not a track, so the pour carries the merge at 2.8-4.3 mm of copper (well above the 1.75 mm IPC-2152 requirement) and hands the trunk off to rule-width tracks east of the pad column.
